clio-starter-annual-subscription.title: Clio Starter subscription cost per year, by seat count
clio-starter-annual-subscription.caption: Calculation: Starter's listed starting rate of $49 per user per month × seats × 12 months. Excludes taxes, add-ons, payment fees, and any annual-billing discount.

clio-payment-fee-rates.title: Clio Payments fee rates by payment method (U.S.)
clio-payment-fee-rates.caption: Percentage of each payment collected. Clio does not publish a current eCheck rate on these pages; confirm it in the quote.
clio-payment-fee-rates.source: Clio payments comparison page and Clio Help Center (Accepted Payment Methods), checked October 2, 2026

clio-subscription-vs-card-fees.title: Illustration: 10 Starter seats vs. card fees at three collection levels
clio-subscription-vs-card-fees.caption: Illustrative calculation, not a quote. Subscription: 10 × $49 × 12. Card fees: monthly card collections × 12 × 2.95%. Assumes every payment uses a standard card.
clio-subscription-vs-card-fees.source: Verdict Point calculation from Clio's published rates, checked October 2, 2026

mycase-plan-prices.title: MyCase price per user per month, by billing term
mycase-plan-prices.caption: Listed U.S. rates per user per month. Annual billing is the lower rate on every plan. Sales tax may apply.
mycase-plan-prices.source: MyCase pricing page and Help Center cost article, checked October 2, 2026

mycase-annual-billing-savings.title: Yearly savings per user from annual billing
mycase-annual-billing-savings.caption: Calculation: (monthly-billing rate minus annual-billing rate) × 12. Matches the per-plan savings MyCase shows on its pricing page.
mycase-annual-billing-savings.source: MyCase pricing page and Help Center cost article, checked October 2, 2026

mycase-ten-user-annual-cost.title: Illustration: yearly cost for 10 users on annual billing
mycase-ten-user-annual-cost.caption: Illustrative calculation, not a quote. Subscription: annual-billing rate × 10 users × 12. Accounting: $39 × 10 users × 12, only if every user needs it. Excludes tax and payment processing.
mycase-ten-user-annual-cost.source: Verdict Point calculation from MyCase published rates, checked October 2, 2026

marketing-channel-investment-2024-2025.title: Share of law firms investing in each marketing channel, 2024 vs. 2025 (approximate)
marketing-channel-investment-2024-2025.caption: Approximate values measured from Clio chart 4.14, which shows bars without data labels; read to the nearest point. Survey of U.S. legal professionals (1,702 respondents in 2025).
marketing-channel-investment-2024-2025.source: Clio, 2025 Legal Trends Report, chart 4.14 (accessed October 2, 2026)

google-ads-cpc-by-industry-2026.title: Average Google Ads cost per click by industry, 2026
google-ads-cpc-by-industry-2026.caption: Average cost per click across U.S. search campaigns in 23 industries, April 2025 to March 2026. Legal had the highest CPC of all industries measured.
google-ads-cpc-by-industry-2026.source: WordStream and LocaliQ, Google Ads Benchmarks 2026 (updated September 16, 2026)

google-ads-cpl-by-industry-2026.title: Average Google Ads cost per lead by industry, 2026
google-ads-cpl-by-industry-2026.caption: Average cost per lead across the same campaigns. A lead is an inquiry, not a signed client. Legal had the highest CPL of all industries measured.
google-ads-cpl-by-industry-2026.source: WordStream and LocaliQ, Google Ads Benchmarks 2026 (updated September 16, 2026)

law-firm-intake-responsiveness-2024.title: How 500 law firms handled a prospective client inquiry, 2024
law-firm-intake-responsiveness-2024.caption: Mystery-shopper study: a third-party research firm contacted 500 U.S. law firms by phone and email with a client inquiry in 2024. Next-step and cost-estimate shares are from phone conversations.

law-firms-by-enterprise-size-2022.title: U.S. law firms by enterprise employment size, 2022
law-firms-by-enterprise-size-2022.caption: Number of firms in Offices of Lawyers (NAICS 541110). Size is total employees across the enterprise, not lawyers or one office. Bands above 9 employees combine non-overlapping Census rows.
law-firms-by-enterprise-size-2022.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2022 Statistics of U.S. Businesses, NAICS 541110 (released April 10, 2025)

law-firm-share-firms-employment-receipts.title: Share of firms, employment, and receipts by enterprise size, 2022
law-firm-share-firms-employment-receipts.caption: Calculation from Census counts: 156,583 firms, 1,078,148 employees, and $356.2 billion in receipts. The 500-or-more group is the industry total minus the under-500 subtotal.
law-firm-share-firms-employment-receipts.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2022 Statistics of U.S. Businesses, NAICS 541110 (released April 10, 2025)

law-firm-receipts-per-firm-2022.title: Average receipts per firm by enterprise size, 2022
law-firm-receipts-per-firm-2022.caption: Calculation: receipts divided by firms in each band, in thousands of dollars. An average, not a median; receipts are revenue, not profit or owner income.
law-firm-receipts-per-firm-2022.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2022 Statistics of U.S. Businesses, NAICS 541110 (released April 10, 2025)

practice-management-published-prices.title: Published per-user monthly prices: Clio and MyCase (Filevine publishes none)

series.name: Listed price per user per month

practice-management-published-prices.caption: Clio Starter is a starting rate; MyCase rates are annual-billing prices. Filevine does not appear because its pricing page lists no per-user price and directs buyers to a custom quote.
practice-management-published-prices.source: Clio, MyCase, and Filevine pricing pages, checked October 2 and 3, 2026

aba-legal-technology-use-2024.title: Technology use reported in the ABA 2024 Legal Technology Survey
aba-legal-technology-use-2024.caption: Each bar describes a different group, named in its label. The figures are separate findings and should not be averaged or added.
aba-legal-technology-use-2024.source: American Bar Association, release on the 2024 Legal Technology Survey Report (March 3, 2025)

law-firm-technology-budgeting-2024.title: Technology budgeting at law firms, 2024
labels: Firms of 50 to 99 lawyers with a technology budget
All respondents whose firm budgets for technology
Solo practitioners with no technology budget
Budgeting firms whose budget stayed the same
law-firm-technology-budgeting-2024.caption: The first three bars use different respondent groups. The last two apply only to firms that budget for technology. Percentages only; no dollar amounts.
law-firm-technology-budgeting-2024.source: American Bar Association, 2024 Budgeting and Planning TechReport

generative-ai-use-law-firms-legal-depart.title: Organizations using generative AI, 2025 vs. 2026
generative-ai-use-law-firms-legal-depart.caption: Organization-level use as summarized by the publisher. Not a measure of personal use by individual lawyers.
generative-ai-use-law-firms-legal-depart.source: Thomson Reuters, How AI Is Transforming the Legal Profession (July 2, 2026)
